description: This Java source file defines an Android activity (CardFlipActivity) demonstrating a card-flip animation using custom fragment transactions, including fragment classes for front and back of a card, menu handling, and animation logic.

classes.name: CardFlipActivity
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating card-flip animation with fragment transactions, menu handling, and back stack management.

classes.name: CardFrontFragment
classes.description: Fragment representing the front side of the card.

classes.name: CardBackFragment
classes.description: Fragment representing the back side of the card.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, adds front fragment if no saved state, and sets back stack listener.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates action bar menu with flip button, icon varies based on card side.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, including navigation up and flip action.

methods.name: flipCard
methods.description: Performs card flip animation by replacing fragments with custom animations and managing back stack.

methods.name: onBackStackChanged
methods.description: Updates UI state based on back stack changes.
